title: FeliCa Smart Cards
description: FeliCa smart cards for high-speed transit, campus, loyalty and secure access applications, built around Sony's 13.56 MHz contactless platform.
summary: FeliCa cards are high-speed contactless smart cards used for transit, campus, payment and secure access programs, especially where Sony's FeliCa ecosystem is already specified.
FeliCa is designed for quick transactions, making it suitable for environments where high-speed processing is needed, like public transit systems or retail payments.
FeliCa card supports strong encryption, making it secure for applications involving sensitive data, such as payments or personal identification.

faq.question: What are FeliCa Smart Cards commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for Japan- and Asia-oriented transit, campus, payment, loyalty, and secure access projects that rely on the FeliCa ecosystem.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for FeliCa Smart Cards?
faq.answer: Chip: Felica Lite S Protocol: JIS X 6319-4 / ISO/IEC18092 / NFC FORUM TYPE 3 TAG Frequency: 13.56 mhz Read Range: 2-10cm, depending on readers

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for FeliCa Smart Cards?
faq.answer: Material: PVC, PET, PETG. Size: CR80 (85.5*54mm) or customized. Color: White.

faq.question: How can FeliCa Smart Cards be customized?
faq.answer: Printing Options: Offset Printing, Silk-screen printing, UV printing, digital printing, etc
